newsitem.title: USA: KBF Pollution settle NY lab charges.
newsitem.headline: KBF Pollution settle NY lab charges.

text.p: KBF Pollution Management Inc said Tuesday that it has pleaded guilty to a single Class 'A' Misdemeanor relating to laboratory record keeping and reporting and will pay a $25,000 fine.
The 27-month investigation was conducted by the District Attorney's office and investigative branch of the New York State Department of Environmental Conservation.
KBF said that all other charges against the company and all charge against its president and chief operating officer, Lawrence Kreisler, have been dropped.

According to the company, the laboratory record keeping and reporting deficiency, the result of criminally negligent actions by former laboratory management personnel, occurred prior to October 2, 1992.

When management learned of this breakdown in its internal control procedures, controls were put in place which management is satisfied have successfully prevented any reoccurrence of the earlier problem, it said.
